name: Tumbes
summary_text: This division was covered by the dedicated country dossier, which identified no deviation from the national position material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed at the national score.

sources.title: Congreso aprueba norma que atenta contra el derecho de las personas trans a usar baños públicos - Infobae
sources.claim_summary: Infobae Peru (20 Feb 2025): Congress's Women and Family Commission unanimously approved a bill barring trans people from public restrooms of the sex other than their birth sex (bills 6506 and 8457, by two governing-bloc legislators), with exceptions for custody situations, medical care, and accompanying elderly, under-12 or disabled people; the initiative also requires removing restroom signage ambiguous about who may enter. Trigger was a July 2023 complaint about gendered toilet labels at Lima's international airport. National law - applies in Puno as everywhere; still requires full plenary approval.

sources.title: Discriminación legalizada: sobre la prohibición del Congreso a personas trans para acceder a baños públicos - IDEHPUCP
sources.claim_summary: IDEHPUCP human-rights institute analysis (15 April 2025), 'Legalised discrimination': on 2 April 2025 Congress's plenary approved, waiving a second vote, the children's-sexual-rights law, fused by the Women and Family Commission with the trans bathroom-restriction bills; critiques the measure as institutionalised discrimination against trans people under national human-rights standards.

sources.title: Perú: aumentaron los crímenes de odio y las mujeres trans son las más afectadas - Agencia Presentes
sources.claim_summary: Agencia Presentes (22 July 2024): the UPCH TLGBI Rights Observatory's annual report records 54 LGBTI killings and 170 rights violations 2020-2023, trans women the most affected (30 of 54), gay men 23, one lesbian; 19 homicides in 2023 alone (12 trans women, 7 gay men). Documents the Feb 2023 abduction of trans sex worker Rubí Torres Silvano, 31, from central Lima by the Los Gallegos gang and her murder in Carabayllo with ~30 gunshot wounds, within a pattern of gang extortion of sex workers. National stats - no department-specific cut.
